facts.gradeRange: With its breathtaking landscapes, diverse climbing routes, and vibrant climbing community, Istria offers an unforgettable experience for both beginners and seasoned climbers alike.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Istria is a cross-border peninsula climbing region with many sport crags and some deep-water soloing.

sections.heading: Who it suits
